views.label: 1. Webhook Gate & Redis Lock

views.label: 2. Dual-Pass AI & Math Reconciler
views.note: Pass 1 (Trip) and Pass 2 (Guests, Dates, Dive Window) run in parallel, followed by deterministic math reconciliation.

cards.title: Stage 1: Webhook Security & Phone Lock
items: Validates X-Hub-Signature-256 and claims WAMID fence token in Upstash Redis
Acquires per-phone mutex lock so rapid WhatsApp bursts coalesce into one turn
Loads full multi-turn conversation transcript (up to 20 turns)

cards.title: Stage 2–3: Dual-Pass AI & Symbolic Math Gate
items: Pass 1 extracts 14 Trip fields while Pass 2 isolates Guest Count, Check-In & Dive Window
60s Circuit Breaker switches between DeepSeek Flash and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite on any error
Symbolic Reconciler overrides LLM math errors (e.g., updating 10 -> 8 guests, split dive days)

cards.title: Stage 4: Fact Gate & Staff Alert Handoff
items: Synthesizes warm English reply asking only missing slots (NEVER RE-ASK known facts)
Post-generation Fact Gate rejects any hallucinated prices or unauthorized discounts
When 6 core fields are complete (done=true), emits verified Trip JSON + Staff Alerts
